releaseName: A sync could duplicate a payment
notes: Fixed: syncing could bring back a scheduled payment that had already gone through, as a second copy still marked pending — which would then have been applied again the next time you opened the app, moving your balance by an amount you never paid. Syncing now recognises a scheduled payment and the applied version of it as the same payment.

If a sync already left you with a duplicate, this update removes it for you the first time you open the app, before anything can be applied. Only a pending copy that exactly matches a payment already applied is removed, and you are told it happened.
Removed a stray amber line that ran down the inside of the Google Drive dialog.
